title: Warm Crunchy Slovakian Pork Skillet
description: A hearty and spicy Slovakian dish featuring harissa spice and pork, perfect for a hangover cure or a comforting meal. This recipe is sugar-free-friendly and packed with flavor.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the crushed bacon until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside.
Add the pork to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the harissa spice, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 20 minutes.
Stir in the cooked bacon and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the pork mixture hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
